verdict.rationale: CT Corporation is a compliance and registered-agent service, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question and the axis applies. Neither probe found any OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The main host returned a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403), and the legacy host only redirects into it, so no spec or developer documentation was observable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
